title: No-Bake Pumpkin Pie
description: This no-bake pumpkin pie has a rich and creamy filling in a prepared graham cracker crust. An excellent make-ahead dessert for the holidays!

steps.text: Combine gelatin, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt in a heavy saucepan; stir in condensed milk and beaten eggs, mixing well. Let stand one minute, then place on burner over low heat, stirring constantly until gelatin dissolves and mixture thickens, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Stir in pumpkin until thoroughly combined; pour mixture into graham cracker crust. Chill for at least 3 hours before serving.

video.description: This is the only pumpkin pie recipe you’ll need this fall. In this video, Nicole shows you how to make no-bake pumpkin pie with an easy homemade filling that comes together on the stovetop in just 10 minutes. For some pumpkin pie cheesecake vibes, this recipe also features a graham cracker crust that lets you show off the very best of both worlds. Once refrigerated and set, top with fresh whipped cream and freshly grated nutmeg, then enjoy every perfect bite of this quintessential fall dessert.
